## Checklist (CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] CHANGELOG.md entry (SemVer; BREAKING marked; "Library layout" if the contract changes)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; the test count does not fall
- [ ] Docs match the code (searched `README.md` and `docs/` for the old text)
- [ ] SPDX header in new files; no scores, scans, private addresses or personal data
- [ ] `tools/check-repo.sh` and the tests pass
